title: The canonical local-scheme section comparison
statement: Let X be a scheme in universe u+1 [def-pc-scheme], i : X.Opens -> X.Etale [def-sc-zariski-site, def-weil-pbc-etale-site] with i followed by forget to Over X equal to X.restrictFunctor, and x a point. Let H be a functor from abelian etale sheaves on X to abelian etale sheaves on Spec(O_X,x), with coefficients AddCommGrpCat.{u+1} [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves], and adj an adjunction of H to direct image along X.fromSpecStalk x. Define D_F on opposite open neighbourhoods by D_F(U)=F(i(U)). The object e_U : i(U) -> U in Over X is the equality isomorphism induced by the supplied equality of functors. The canonical map l_U : Spec(O_X,x) -> i(U) is the map to the canonical open U followed by e_U inverse. Base change gives a section s_U of i(U) pulled back to Spec(O_X,x). The cocone leg is the component of adj.unit at i(U), followed by restriction along s_U. These legs induce a natural transformation from etaleObjectStalkSections X i x to H followed by terminal sections on Spec(O_X,x). The map sends each colimit coprojection to that explicitly constructed cocone leg.

source.place: Lemma 59.51.5, degree zero, proof steps (1)-(3), restricted to principal opens in an affine neighbourhood of x.

proof.text: Use Scheme.Opens.fromSpecStalkOfMem and the equality-induced isomorphism in Over X to construct l_U. Its composite with i(U).hom is X.fromSpecStalk x. The morphism i(U).hom is an open immersion, hence monic. Cancelling it proves compatibility of the l_U under inclusions. Pullback.lift constructs s_U and pullback.hom_ext proves its compatibility.

Compose the sheaf adjunction unit with restriction along s_U. Naturality of the unit and of s_U gives a cocone on D_F. Apply colimit.desc to each F. Naturality of the adjunction unit in F and of the sheaf morphism H.map f proves naturality of these colimit maps. colimit.ι_desc gives the formula for a neighbourhood section.
